verses.text: Whenever I want to heal Israel, the sins of Ephraim are exposed, and so are the crimes of Samaria. They lie and cheat. Thieves break into houses, and bandits rob people in the streets.
They do not realize that I remember all their wicked deeds. Now their sins surround them, and they are always in front of me.
They please the king with their wickedness and the officials with their lies.
They are all adulterers. They burn with passion like an oven whose fire the baker does not need to stir from the time he kneads the dough until it rises.
On the king's special day, the officials get sick from the heat of wine, and the king joins hands with those who mock.
Their hearts are like an oven as they plot against him. Their anger smolders all night, and in the morning it blazes up like a flaming fire.
All of them are as hot as an oven, and they destroy their rulers. All their kings fall, and not one of them calls on me.
Ephraim mixes with the nations. Ephraim is like a flat loaf of bread that was never turned over.
Foreigners eat up his strength, but he does not realize it. His hair is turning gray, but he does not notice.
Israel's pride testifies against him. Yet in spite of all this, the people do not return to the LORD their God or look for him.
"Ephraim is like a dove, easily fooled and without sense. First they call to Egypt for help, then they turn to Assyria.
When they go, I will throw my net over them and pull them down like birds of the sky. I will punish them, just as I warned their assembly.
How terrible it will be for them, because they have wandered away from me! Destruction will come on them, because they have rebelled against me. I wanted to rescue them, but they tell lies about me.
They do not cry out to me from their hearts. Instead, they wail on their beds. They gather together for grain and new wine, but they turn away from me.
I trained them and made them strong, yet they plot evil against me.

They turn, but not to the Most High God. They are like a bow that does not shoot straight. Their leaders will be killed by the sword because of their insulting words. For this they will be laughed at in the land of Egypt.
